About Me

Learning by building,
shipping every day.

I'm Hammad Khan, a web developer and Computer Science student at City University of Science and Information Technology, Peshawar. I build complete, working web apps with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, PHP and MySQL, from the database schema to the final responsive page.

I learn by shipping. I build small full-stack projects twice a day, push every one to GitHub, and write about what I learned. My projects cover task management, expense tracking, habit tracking and a personal library, all built with secure PDO prepared statements and clean Bootstrap layouts.
